newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-WEDNESDAY'S SCHEDULE OF MATCHES AT THE FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-WEDNESDAY'S SCHEDULE OF MATCHES AT THE FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Schedule of matches on Centre Court at the French Open tennis championships on Wednesday (all matches quarter-finals; play starts 1000 GMT; prefix number denotes seeding):
Men's singles Patrick Rafter (Australia) v Galo Blanco (Spain) Hicham Arazi (Morocco) v 16-Sergi Bruguera (Spain)
Women's doubles 8-Alexandra Fusai/Nathalie Tauziat (France) v 10-Conchita Martinez (Spain)/Patricia Tarabini (Argentina)
Mixed doubles 2-Manon Bollegraf (Netherlands)/Rick Leach (U.S.) v 7-Brenda Schultz-McCarthy (Netherlands)/Piet Norval (South Africa)
